features.name: Financial Health Score
features.description: Calculates your overall financial health score (0-100) and status based on savings ratio, debt-to-income ratio, and emergency fund coverage.
examples: What is my health score?
How is my financial health?

features.name: Expense Analyzer
features.description: Breaks down monthly expenses by category, detects highest expenditure areas, and visualizes categories on the dashboard.
examples: Where did I spend the most?
Show my expense categories.

features.name: Emergency Fund Planner
features.description: Calculates safe emergency savings target (covering 3 to 6 months of expenses) and compares it with your current savings buffer.
examples: Do I have enough emergency fund?
How much should I save for emergencies?

features.name: Goal Planner
features.description: Allows creating and tracking financial goals (e.g. buying a car, vacation, retirement) with progress indicators and monthly target savings.
examples: List my goals
How much do I need to save for my vacation goal?

features.name: Linked Accounts Feed
features.description: Connects mock banking feeds, investment ledgers, and insurance assets to sync balances directly in the Settings workspace.
examples: How do I link my bank account?
Show my linked banking ledgers.

features.name: Universal Statement Parser
features.description: Uploads and parses CSV, Excel, or PDF bank statements to normalize transactions and automatically categorize ledgers.
examples: How to upload my bank statement?
Analyze my CSV ledger.

features.name: Premium Investment Advisor
features.description: Generates tailored investment allocations (Cash, Bonds, Equities) based on age, income, and risk tolerance, providing short and long term strategies.
examples: Give me investment recommendations.
What are my optimal investment allocations?

features.name: Premium Insurance Advisor
features.description: Analyzes family size, dependents, and income to recommend coverage amounts and levels for Term, Health, and Accidental Insurance policies.
examples: How much insurance do I need?
Do I need health insurance?

features.name: Premium Tax Optimizer
features.description: Evaluates HRA, HRA rent limits, 80C and 80D deductions, and home loans to optimize taxable income and suggest tax-saving strategies.
examples: Optimize my taxes
How can I save tax under Section 80C?

features.name: Premium Loan Advisor
features.description: Analyzes credit score, existing EMI debt, and income to calculate safety thresholds, safe EMIs, and maximum eligible loan amounts.
examples: Am I eligible for a home loan?
What is my maximum safe EMI?

features.name: Premium Purchase Affordability Advisor
features.description: Analyzes costs and items (e.g. buying an iPhone) against monthly parameters, goals, and savings to give a purchase score and Buy/Wait/Avoid advice.
examples: Can I afford a ₹1,00,000 laptop?
Should I buy a new phone now?

features.name: Premium Financial Twin
features.description: Creates an AI-driven digital twin of your financial behavior to simulate future decisions, run cash flow scenarios, and test budget changes.
examples: Talk to my financial twin
Simulate my future savings ratio.

features.name: Data & Reports
features.description: Compiles comprehensive financial summaries and downloads them as professionally formatted PDF or CSV documents.
examples: Can I download my expense report?
Export my financial telemetry.
